ApiHub.title: API-Hub Integration System
ApiHub.subtitle: Serverless central repository managing all company integrations
ApiHub.description: The API-Hub is a serverless repository responsible for handling all integrations and data workflows within the company. Every integration and routine passes through this system, including all payment system interactions with Oracle NetSuite: Payment System → API-Hub → NetSuite. I am responsible for developing, maintaining, and, in new projects, choosing the appropriate architecture to implement.
features: Centralized handling of all company integrations
Serverless architecture for scalability and reliability
Integration layer between payment system and Oracle NetSuite
Responsible for development, maintenance, and architecture decisions in new projects

JiveMauaPay.title: JiveMauaPay – Internal Payment System
JiveMauaPay.subtitle: Full-stack development and maintenance of the company's internal payment system
JiveMauaPay.description: I am responsible for full-stack development, maintenance, and implementing new features in JiveMauaPay, the internal payment system that processes around half a billion reais. The system centralizes and facilitates company payments, including payment approvals and spending limits. My work includes developing integrations with Oracle NetSuite ERP, Bubble, and external systems, refactoring code, optimizing performance, and automating routines.
features: Full-stack development and maintenance
Implementation of new functionalities and code refactoring
Integration with Oracle NetSuite, Bubble, and external systems
Payment approval workflows and spending limits
Performance optimization and automation of routines

Suppliers.title: Supplier Management Module
Suppliers.subtitle: Automated supplier registration integrated with Oracle NetSuite ERP
Suppliers.description: Within the company's payment system, I developed a complete supplier registration module fully integrated with the Oracle NetSuite ERP. The module allowed registering suppliers with essential data such as name, document, bank account, and address. Previously, the IT team manually registered suppliers in both the payment system and the ERP through support tickets. My development automated this process, reducing around 25% of the support team's workload.
features: Front-end form with field validations for supplier data
Backend APIs for database persistence
API integration with NetSuite via AWS Step Functions
Database schema updates with new tables, columns, and triggers
Reduction of ~25% in support ticket volume

BackgroundCheck.title: Background Check Automation
BackgroundCheck.subtitle: Automated compliance workflow for supplier risk assessment
BackgroundCheck.description: I implement a complete background check flow integrated with the company's payment system and internal intranet (Bubble.io). After a supplier is registered, the compliance team receives an automatically created record in Bubble.io via API, containing five customizable questions to assess impact, probability, and overall risk. Based on the evaluation, compliance can approve or reject the supplier directly from Bubble.io without accessing the payment system. The solution also sends daily email reminders about pending checks. This process, previously handled manually through spreadsheets, is now fully automated, resulting in an estimated 80% time savings for the compliance team.
features: Automatic creation of compliance records via API
Customizable risk evaluation criteria
Integration between payment system and Bubble.io intranet
Daily email reminders for pending checks
80% reduction in compliance processing time

LoginPage.title: Video Conference Login Page
LoginPage.subtitle: Access point for users to log in or sign up to the company's video conferencing system

Users could log in with existing credentials or create a new account directly from the interface, ensuring quick and secure access to virtual meetings.
features: Integrated login and registration form
Secure authentication and data handling
User-friendly and responsive interface
